## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally (typecheck, lint, tests, build)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, and `CHANGELOG.md` under "Unreleased")
- [ ] New game or art: original name, art and sound, no third-party trademarks (see `docs/LEGAL.md`)
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or site-specific network addresses (the hygiene test checks this)
